title: Custom Mobs
description: This mod adds new variations of mobs
body:
This mod adds new variations of vanilla mobs and will add to your world fresh minecraft experience. These new variations are unique and come with new appearences (sometimes appearence depends on biome) and new abilities which can make user experience better and bit more difficult.

This mod includes:
-3 new variants of creeper,
-5 new variants of skeleton,
-5 new variants of zombie,
-2 new variants of enderman,
-1 new variant of spider,
-2 new variants of squid,
-1 new variant of wither,
-1 new variant of zombified piglin,
-2 new variant of wither skeleton,
-1 new variant of goat,
-1 new variant of frog,
-1 new variant of magma cube,
-2 new variants of slime,
-1 new variant of strider
